quiet_luxury_commute.prompt: wearing an ivory silk shirt tucked into taupe high-waisted wide-leg trousers, finished with a slim leather belt and understated loafers
quiet_luxury_commute.prompt_zh: 穿着象牙白真丝衬衫与灰褐色高腰垂坠阔腿裤，搭配纤细皮带和简洁乐福鞋，呈现低饱和静奢通勤感

relaxed_intellectual.prompt: wearing a charcoal fine-knit cardigan over a crisp white shirt with fluid pleated trousers and polished leather loafers
relaxed_intellectual.prompt_zh: 穿着炭灰色细针织开衫、挺括白衬衫与垂坠褶裥长裤，搭配精致皮质乐福鞋，呈现松弛知识分子风

soft_korean_date.prompt: wearing a powder-blue fitted knit top with a cream A-line midi skirt, delicate flats, and minimal jewelry
soft_korean_date.prompt_zh: 穿着雾霾蓝合身针织上衣与奶油色 A 字中长裙，搭配精致平底鞋和极简首饰，呈现温柔韩系约会感

modern_new_chinese.prompt: wearing a modern stand-collar jacquard blouse with subtle frog-button details, paired with a flowing black column skirt and restrained jade-toned accents
modern_new_chinese.prompt_zh: 穿着带有克制盘扣细节的现代立领提花上衣与流畅黑色直身长裙，点缀低调玉色配饰，呈现现代新中式气质

retro_citywalk.prompt: wearing a cropped brown suede jacket over a fine-knit top with high-waisted straight blue jeans and vintage leather loafers
retro_citywalk.prompt_zh: 穿着短款棕色麂皮夹克、细针织内搭与高腰直筒蓝色牛仔裤，搭配复古皮质乐福鞋，呈现轻复古 CityWalk 风格

refined_sportique.prompt: wearing a structured lightweight zip jacket over a fitted athletic top with clean straight-leg track trousers and minimalist sneakers
refined_sportique.prompt_zh: 穿着轻盈挺括的拉链运动外套、合身运动内搭与简洁直筒运动长裤，搭配极简运动鞋，呈现精致 Sportique 风格

minimal_gray_studio.prompt: in a spacious minimalist gray portrait studio with generous negative space, soft directional light, and subtle floor shadows
minimal_gray_studio.prompt_zh: 位于宽敞的极简灰色人像摄影棚，保留大量留白，使用柔和方向光与细腻地面阴影

window_light_apartment.prompt: in a refined modern apartment beside floor-to-ceiling windows, with sheer curtains, warm natural daylight, and restrained neutral furnishings
window_light_apartment.prompt_zh: 位于落地窗旁的精致现代公寓，薄纱窗帘透入温暖自然光，陈设克制且采用中性色调

warm_wood_cafe.prompt: by the window of a quiet warm-wood cafe, with soft side light, textured plaster walls, and an intimate editorial atmosphere
warm_wood_cafe.prompt_zh: 位于安静的暖木色咖啡馆窗边，柔和侧光落在肌理墙面上，呈现亲密而高级的杂志氛围

cinematic_blue_hour_street.prompt: on an elegant city street at blue hour after light rain, with cinematic storefront glow, subtle reflections, and controlled background depth
cinematic_blue_hour_street.prompt_zh: 位于细雨后的城市蓝调时刻街道，店铺灯光具有电影感，路面带有克制反光与清晰景深层次

contemporary_art_gallery.prompt: inside a contemporary art gallery with pale stone walls, monumental clean architecture, diffused skylight, and museum-like quiet
contemporary_art_gallery.prompt_zh: 位于当代艺术展馆，浅色石材墙面与简洁宏大的建筑线条被漫射天光照亮，氛围安静而高级

golden_hour_coast.prompt: on a quiet open coastline at golden hour, with pale sand, calm water, warm rim light, and an uncluttered horizon
golden_hour_coast.prompt_zh: 位于黄金时刻的宁静开阔海岸，浅色沙滩、平静海面与温暖轮廓光共同构成干净无遮挡的地平线
